Hi guys, made an account after many years of lurking just to help. Often what happens on older plumbing systems is one of two things. Based on your description the main water shut off is the issue. This is typically a gate valve if not excercised properly the “gate” can break when you go to use it, only providing a partial flow. The reason you get full pressure at first is the water squeezes past the small opening and pressurizes the system. Check it at the well if possible before the main shut off. Second possible issue at time well systems can have more debris in the system than a typical municipal Water source. You could just have “junk” built up that became dislodged when shutting of the water. A bit harder to locate but I would start by checking at the shutoff, as it is affecting the entire system.
